title: NayaPOWER Governed Execution Identity Binding V1

execution_authorization.binding_rule: The authorization is valid only when canonical authority, decision, exact action, identity fingerprint, and identity/action binding all match.
execution_authorization.authority_rule: Identity never mints, expands, delegates, or modifies authority.
execution_authorization.verification_rule: Verification requires the same governed identity envelope that was present at authorization time.
execution_authorization.issuance_rule: The verification boundary accepts only the authorization object issued by the same in-process gate instance.

smart_ledger.integrity_rule: All identity/action binding fields participate in the deterministic ledger integrity hash.
smart_ledger.receipt_rule: The verification receipt repeats the identity and execution binding fields carried by the ledger event.
smart_ledger.tamper_rule: Changing identity or action binding data without recomputing the ledger integrity hash must fail verification.
